notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:




 Fixed a bug where elite enemies would act weird while chasing the player.
 Resolved an issue where paladins and berserkers had achieved unintended immortality.
 Fixed the bug that caused towers to upgrade infinitely.
 Took care of a few animation bugs.
 Added a refund button to the permanent upgrades menu.
 Made some changes to text for better clarity.



We appreciate your support and hope you enjoy the improvements!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.3
notes.notes:
Bug fixes:


 Permanent upgrades are now safely saved—no more disappearing upgrades!
 Fixed an issue with the save system that reset the day counter to 1 when reloading. Time marches on properly now!
 We double-checked and made sure the tower upgrade bug is truly gone.
 Addressed a few sneaky bugs in the assault team’s behavior. They should be fighting fit now!


Thanks for sticking with us, and stay tuned for more improvements!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:


 Bug Fix: Fixed an issue where archer towers would endlessly consume coins without upgrading.
 Coin Mischief: Some coins were trying to fly away from time to time. We kindly reminded them they are, in fact, coins and should stay put!
 Bug Fix: Resolved a bug that caused soldiers to stop moving after our walls were destroyed.
 Tweak: Made a minor adjustment to permanent upgrades.
 Holy Knight Update: Our Holy Knight was randomly joining the defense line. We made sure it reads the holy book unless we specifically call it to battle!
 UI Improvement: Updated some of our UI texts to enhance user experience.
 Enemy Coordination: We encouraged enemies to fight together. After all, a mage without their squad is just a lonely spellcaster, right?


We’ll keep improving the game to ensure you have more fun (We know that nobody likes bugs, Don't worry🤗) 

Stay tuned, and thanks for playing!

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0.1
notes.notes:
New Features & Improvements

 Added additional log files to the bug report tool to help track down and resolve issues more effectively.


Bug Fixes

 Level Up Error: Fixed a bug where an error occurred when leveling up from level 4 to level 5.
 Infinite Building Loop: Addressed an issue where builders would infinitely construct walls, causing gameplay interruptions.
 Various small bug fixes and optimizations to improve overall game stability.

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 0.9.13
notes.notes:
Hey Builders!

👑Thank you for playing The Monarch! 👑

Here's the patch notes for v0.9.13:


 Bug Fixes: We've zapped those annoying bugs for a smoother gameplay experience.
 New Game+: Once you finish the game, you can start again in a more challenging mode.


Keep the feedback coming, and happy building!

Please let us know when you encounter any issue on our Discord or Steam community so that we can fix it asap.

Thank you and have fun! 🏹

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 0.9.8
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

👑Thank you for playing The Monarch! 👑

Here's the patch notes for v0.9.8:


 Fixed a crash issue that occurred when attempting to gain a skill.
 Fixed an issue (this time for real!) where experience gems could go beyond collision zones.
 Fixed a bug that caused peasant units to get stuck during the town center upgrade.
 Addressed some save-related bugs.
 Corrected a bug where the Wild Boar would get stuck in the running animation and become invulnerable.
 Resolved an issue where the Main Menu appeared in a different language than selected.
 Fixed a bug where archers could sometimes stall while enemies were attacking the wall.



Please let us know when you encounter any issue on our Discord or Steam community so that we can fix it asap.

Thank you and have fun! 🏹

notes.title: Update notes for Patch 0.9.7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for playing The Monarch!

Here's the patch notes for v0.9.7:

 Enemy units were sometimes getting stuck in combat. This is fixed.
 Some bugs related to save system got fixed.

Please let us know when you encounter any issue on our Discord or Steam community so that we can fix it asap.
